project_info.theme: classic European monochrome street-style menswear portrait
project_info.color_palette: black, light gray, mid gray, and white accents

main_subject.description: A stylish adult man with short layered wavy hair, natural flyaways, light stubble, and a calm confident expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: Tailored black topcoat over a white shirt and dark tie, paired with rectangular dark sunglasses.
main_subject.pose: Standing in a relaxed low-angle three-quarter stance with both hands in the coat pockets and gaze turned slightly away from camera.

composition_elements.framing: Asymmetric rule-of-thirds vertical portrait showing the subject from mid-thigh upward.
composition_elements.environment: Historic European architectural setting with stone balustrade, textured walls, columns, and no readable text or logos.
composition_elements.focus: High-contrast face and sunglasses, then coat lapels, tie, pocketed hands, and architectural background details.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Diffused natural window-like daylight from above with soft gradual shadows beneath the chin, nose, and coat folds.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Elegant, timeless, sophisticated, and slightly mysterious.

technical_specs.camera: Full-frame digital camera with a 50mm lens, f/4, 1/250 s, ISO 200, low-angle perspective
technical_specs.quality: Realistic sharp texture, fine film grain, neutral high-contrast monochrome, medium depth of field, and natural proportions

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 monochrome menswear editorial portrait of a stylish adult man with short layered wavy hair, natural flyaways, light stubble, and a calm confident expression. He wears a tailored black topcoat over a white shirt and dark tie, paired with rectangular dark sunglasses. Place him in an asymmetric rule-of-thirds vertical composition from mid-thigh upward, standing in a relaxed low-angle three-quarter stance with both hands in the coat pockets and his gaze turned slightly away from camera. Use a historic European architectural setting with stone balustrade, textured walls, and columns, diffused daylight from above, soft gradual shadows, fine film grain, neutral high-contrast monochrome, and no readable text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, celebrity likeness, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, readable text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, over-smooth skin, distorted sunglasses, extra fingers, deformed anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for this original adult subject. Optional coat, sunglasses, architecture, or lighting references may replace only their named element; preserve the asymmetric composition, monochrome palette, pocketed-hands pose, and timeless menswear mood.

assets.name: black-topcoat-white-shirt-dark-tie
assets.usage: Replace only the coat, shirt, and tie while preserving the refined tailored silhouette.

assets.name: rectangular-dark-sunglasses
assets.usage: Replace only the sunglasses shape and finish while preserving the understated monochrome styling.
